title: abelmoschus abelmoschus
intro: Abelmoschus abelmoschus, commonly known as Abelmoschus or Hibiscus esculentus, is a species of flowering plant in the mallow family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Abelmoschus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Abelmoschus include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
